notes.title: FM
notes.text: FM: a 2-operator FM percussion model (TUNE DECAY INDEX RATIO, MDEC SWEEP FBK VEL): bells, metallic toms, woodblocks, zaps, FM kicks; 2 voices; the SOUND graph shows the ratio's sidebands.

notes.title: SEQ
notes.text: SEQ: the white keys are the selected track's steps on every SEQ page (STEP, PATTERN, MOTION, SONG) and on TRACKS (tap on / off, hold accent, OCT+ / OCT- the bank); ALGO or TRACKS' KNOB 1 picks the track. TRACKS mutes: REC held + a key (+ top C# / D#: now / next bar), was OCT- held.

notes.title: PERFORM
notes.text: PERFORM: the knobs are the macros whenever the PERFORM screen shows (a held layer key no longer let them edit the page under it).

notes.title: FILTER
notes.text: FILTER: a filter on every track (FX > FILTER: TYPE OFF LP BP HP NOT, CUT, RESO, ENV, DECAY), after RESON, before DIST; each hit sweeps it by ENV (accents further); LFO DEST F.CUT / F.RES. Projects: format FDRA (older ones load with the filter OFF). BENCH: filter, compressor and sidechain cases.

notes.title: COWB
notes.text: COWB: TUNE now moves its pitch (its own 540 / 800 Hz oscillators, the band-pass follows); before, it only moved the filter over fixed partials. At TUNE 0 it sounds as before.
